summary: Source-content restyle seals contained image geometry, avoids SQLite writes during PowerPoint QA, and restores nullable optional Scene fields.
invariants: Contain image bounds in canonical Scene equal the native PPTX picture bounds before Scene sealing.
Source-content generation does not acquire a SQLite writer lock before the long PowerPoint render and reopen QA finishes.
Workbench treats null optional text alignment and crop geometry as absent values.
forbidden: Compare an allocator image frame directly with the aspect-fitted native contain picture bounds.
Persist the generation binding before long-running PowerPoint QA.
